connector.name: Japan Data MCP by Izyuusya
connector.registryDescription: 日本の公的データ（統計・法人・不動産）にAIからアクセスするMCPサーバー。e-Stat統計API・法人番号Web-API・不動産情報ライブラリAPIの3API統合。全国約1,700市区町村対応。
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package japan-data-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the izyuusya account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ESTAT_APP_ID
env.description: e-Stat API Application ID (required). Free at https://www.e-stat.go.jp/api/api-info/api-guide

env.name: CORP_APP_ID
env.description: Corporate Number Web-API Application ID (optional). Apply at https://www.houjin-bangou.nta.go.jp/webapi/

env.name: REALESTATE_API_KEY
env.description: Real Estate Information Library API Key (optional). Apply at https://www.reinfolib.mlit.go.jp/api/request/
